preregistration.scope: Freeze model hyperparameters, quantiles, prediction horizons, conformal calibration, temporal folds, and cost scenarios only.
preregistration.p_hacking_guard: All 30 logical trial slots and the complete evaluation protocol are registered before empirical evaluation. No candidate may be added, removed, retuned, or selectively rerun after outcomes are observed.
preregistration.change_control: Any byte-level change requires explicit written Owner approval and a new superseding preregistration commitment. This file and its SHA-256 must not be silently overwritten.

parameter_rationale.max_depth_and_leaf_count: A shallow depth-3 tree with at most 8 leaves constrains interaction complexity and reduces variance.
parameter_rationale.min_samples_leaf: A 20-row minimum leaf size discourages fitting isolated observations and complements shallow trees.
parameter_rationale.l2_regularization: A fixed positive value of 1.0 regularizes leaf values; it is not a post-hoc tuned value.
parameter_rationale.early_stopping: Disabled to avoid an implicit random validation split and keep temporal partitioning explicit.
parameter_rationale.random_state: Fixed at 42 for deterministic implementation behavior.

walk_forward_protocol.interval_convention: UTC; every interval is start-inclusive and end-exclusive.

purge_policy.rule: Drop any training or calibration decision row whose target interval would extend beyond its own partition boundary. The 24-hour purge equals the maximum registered target horizon.

walk_forward_protocol.embargo_policy: The full one-calendar-month embargo interval is excluded from fitting, conformal calibration, and test scoring.
walk_forward_protocol.anchor_policy: Relative month offsets are fixed here. The absolute UTC anchor T0 must be owner-approved and frozen in a separate data-window authorization before any empirical data is opened; it must not be selected after inspecting outcomes.

cost_scenarios.decision_rule: ENTER only when the valid conformal lower bound is strictly greater than the applicable return_fraction; equality, missing, malformed, or non-finite values produce ABSTAIN.

trial_family.identifier_semantics: Stable legacy logical-slot identifiers are retained for lineage and multiple-testing accounting; the preregistered implementation revision is HGBQ-CQR.
